def test_host_blocked_zero_invoke_calls(supervisor):
    with patch.object(supervisor.relay, "validate_browser_diagnostic_request", side_effect=ValueError("blocked")):
        req = EgressRequest(target="https://evil.example.com", payload={})
        res = supervisor.execute_governed(req, dry_run=False)
        assert res.status == "blocked"
        supervisor.relay.invoke.assert_not_called()


def test_method_blocked_zero_invoke_calls(supervisor):
    req = EgressRequest(target="https://huggingface.co/api/models", payload={}, intent="write")
    with patch.object(supervisor.relay, "validate_browser_diagnostic_request", side_effect=ValueError("method blocked")):
        res = supervisor.execute_governed(req, dry_run=False)
        assert res.status == "blocked"
        supervisor.relay.invoke.assert_not_called()


def test_auth_cookie_xapikey_headers_stripped(supervisor):
    dirty = {"Authorization": "Bearer x", "Cookie": "a=1", "X-Api-Key": "secret", "Accept": "json"}
    clean = supervisor.relay._sanitize_headers(dirty)
    assert "authorization" not in {k.lower() for k in clean}
    assert "cookie" not in {k.lower() for k in clean}
    assert "x-api-key" not in {k.lower() for k in clean}
    assert clean.get("Accept") == "json"


def test_token_budget_denied_blocks_before_invoke(supervisor):
    supervisor.token_budget_checker.return_value = False
    req = EgressRequest(target="https://huggingface.co/api/models", payload={})
    res = supervisor.execute_governed(req, dry_run=False)
    assert res.status == "blocked"
    assert "token_budget" in res.decision.reason
    supervisor.relay.invoke.assert_not_called()


def test_approval_required_blocks_before_invoke(supervisor):
    supervisor.approval_checker.return_value = False
    req = EgressRequest(target="https://huggingface.co/api/models", payload={}, intent="write")
    res = supervisor.execute_governed(req, dry_run=False)
    assert res.status == "require_approval"
    supervisor.relay.invoke.assert_not_called()


def test_memory_state_persisted_and_loaded(supervisor):
    req = EgressRequest(target="https://huggingface.co/api/models", payload={})
    res1 = supervisor.execute_governed(req, dry_run=True, task_id="mem-test-1")
    res2 = supervisor.execute_governed(req, dry_run=True, task_id="mem-test-1")
    assert "steps" in res2.memory_state
    assert len(res2.memory_state["steps"]) >= 1
